chunks: And it was narrated from the Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) that he said:

“Say, ‘I am only a man like you, to whom has been revealed that your god is one God. So whoever hopes for the meeting with his Lord - let him do righteous work and not associate in the worship of his Lord anyone.’”
“A light shines for him towards the Sacred Mosque, and the filling of that light is angels seeking forgiveness for him until morning.”
“And as for what he mentioned after that until the end of the chapter, its explanation has passed in full detail, and the favor is to God.”
ai.seo_question: What is the spiritual benefit of reciting Surah Al-Kahf before sleeping?
ai.summary: Recorded in Shaykh al-Tusi’s *Tahdhib al-Ahkam*, this hadith highlights the spiritual efficacy of reciting the concluding verses of Surah Al-Kahf before sleep, linking the act to divine illumination and angelic intercession. The imagery of light extending to the Kaaba signifies the reciter’s spiritual alignment with the holiest site, while the presence of angels seeking forgiveness underscores the purification of the soul for the coming day.
